messages:
alex: quick question — how should we route requests with no project claim but with an org header? do we put them on a 'consent' quota or default org?

rachel: we currently fallback to org-less bucket which has weird billing spikes. +1 to a consent bucket so legal can opt-in.

sam: the problem is telemetry. if we route to consent bucket we lose attribution. can we emit a "consent.routing" tag instead and keep origin null for billing?

tony: emit tag + keep metrics, yes. but quota enforcement needs a key. what if we do temporary sticky routing by key-prefix (first 8 chars) to avoid thundering? :thinking_face: 

alex: sticky by prefix seems hacky but pragmatic. how long should sticky last? 24h? 1h?

jen: 1h TTL seems safer. also add sampling so we don't capture PII in logs. auth-bot: sample-rate=0.01 configured for consent bucket.

auth-bot: deploy notice: sampling policy 0.01 applied to /v1/generate for consent-bucket in prod-canary.

sam: telemetry names proposal:
- auth.routing.choice -> values: default_org, consent_bucket, sticky_prefix
- auth.quota.bucket -> bucket_id
- auth.sampled -> true/false

rachel: console UX ask: show "effective quota" and a small badge "routing hint" when a request used sticky routing. also surface sample-rate on the route.

tony: implementation detail: proxy needs to add header `x-routing-hint: sticky-prefix:abcd1234` when sticky applied. code snippet:
```
if (!req.claims.project) {
  route = consentBucket;
  res.setHeader('x-routing-hint', `sticky:${prefix}`)
}
```

alex: migration plan: start canary, watch auth.routing.choice distribution for 48h, then flip default to consent-bucket only if >95% legal signoff. otherwise rollback.

jen: are we comfortable with the billing implications? we should add alert on cost-per-token for consent-bucket.

rachel: +1. create dashboard: Metrics -> auth -> routing -> cost-per-token by bucket. also add alert: > $X/day for consent-bucket.

sam: I'll draft telemetry PR and add unit tests for header propagation. can someone own the console badge? @rachel

rachel: I can. will add a small badge and sample-rate text.

alex: action items:
- sam: PR for metrics + header
- rachel: console badge + dashboard
- tony: proxy sticky TTL defaults
- jen: legal/billing signoff

alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
